clips.title: The story
paras: At the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, Onu enters a deep trance over a growing threat. The ancient of lore weighs the alliance and motives of the Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga. If you lose your scrying phial, you can speak to him for another.

In the Grove of the Ancients, Onu is an Ancient of Lore and a living repository of Kalimdor's history. Ominous reports of dark excavations at the Master's Glaive draw his immense consciousness inward. He ponders what brings the fanatical Twilight's Hammer cultists and the naga to the petrified remains of an ancient behemoth. For adventurers carrying out his reconnaissance, Onu remains within reach and can replace a scrying phial misplaced in the wild.

Onu uses nature-attuned divination to watch the ruins without risking his physical presence. He entrusts adventurers with a phial of scrying, which conjures a scrying bowl at the excavation site so he can commune from afar. The journey south through Darkshore is perilous, with hostile wildlife and cultist patrols, so mishaps can happen. Onu's trance is an attentive vigil, not unbroken slumber. He readily offers another vial of sacred waters so the investigation of the Master's Glaive can continue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am meditating on your task, friend. Meditating on reasons why the Twilight's Hammer and naga are here.
When you are ready, use the phial of scrying to create a scrying bowl. Then, contact me through the bowl.
If you have lost your phial of scrying, then here is another.
